description: This file manages Discord direct message command authorization, including resolving sender permissions, policies, and access decisions based on allow lists and group policies.

methods.name: resolveSenderAllowMatch
methods.description: Resolves whether a sender matches the allow list based on their ID, name, or tag, considering allow list normalization and matching rules.

methods.name: resolveDmPolicyCommandAuthorization
methods.description: Determines if a command is authorized based on the DM policy and access decision.

methods.name: resolveDiscordDmCommandAccess
methods.description: Main function to resolve access rights for a Discord DM command, considering policies, allow lists, and group access.
